status: Authored only; root full-read precedes application/build/execution. No production/input/old-test edit or run by this author.
basis: Genuine retained 1280-ID W or C parallel zero-g global-FreeSlip initialization, same h/dp1.8 and actual CPU arrays/fluid cell list. One input invocation selects one actual kernel; do not change only its label. Two genuine kernel invocations would give eight cases/sixteen query rows total; no execution result is asserted.
private_queries: After successful original InitDynamicPoreWallCpu, temporarily set NpbOk=2. Only two fixed sample slots are moved, with one x-normal and one z-normal mirror target exactly at existing interior fluid nodes (12.5dp,16.5dp) and (20.5dp,16.5dp). Each original query B is target minus an exact 1.5dp axis vector. These are diagnostic interpolation queries inside the cloud, not a physical wall geometry. Fixed-cell membership is not rebuilt because state consumes only the unchanged fluid neighbor cell list; no force/rate or geometry-admission claim is made.
manufacture: Constant J1, zero mechanical velocity/stress and p0; native p=128+rho_w*g dot actual position, rho_w1000, g=(.5,0,1). Both g components are nonzero and every assigned pressure stays within the retained 256-Pa scale. Gravity/CSP.gravity are assigned only after zero-g initialization. Both FreeSlip and NoSlip global selectors are tested, each with first-X/first-Z query order. No unrelated new stress, C, Ace, full-Darcy, force, SH or half-step suite is repeated.
actual_consumer: PreInteraction_Forces allocates existing scratch, then exactly one ComputeDynamicPoreWallStateCpu call per case and normal PosInteraction_Forces cleanup. Four state calls/eight rows per kernel invocation. No C/acceleration/rate/force method, ComputeStep or Run. State does not mutate any native packed26 field, C/Ace/rate arrays or unselected p/J entries; original full positions/normals/IDs/codes/physical inputs are restored after each case. Scope guard restores NpbOk, SlipMode, original mode pointer and both gravity constants before base destruction, including on an exception.
reference_and_budget: Expected pressure is the independently assigned global affine pressure evaluated at actual B, expected J1. Use the original selected-kernel scaled support condition, td=32768 DBL_EPSILON condition, tf=64 FLT_EPSILON condition; pressure error<=256tf and J error<=2td. Each mirror must coincide with a genuine fluid node. No fitted time shift, interpolation, GLS threshold or physical tolerance is added.
counterfactual: Analytically evaluate the old first-normal policy: p_wrong(B)=p_true(B)+rho_w*(g-g_n_first) dot raw_receiver. The first query has zero difference; the other axis must differ by 1.46484375 Pa (X after Z) or 2.9296875 Pa (Z after X). Require this declared margin>2 original pressure budgets and reject the wrong value under that same budget, providing strict distinguishability even allowing one budget of good-result error. This is an analytic affine counterfactual, not an old executable run or a proof for nonlinear pressure.
CLI: helper.exe --state -cpu -ompthreads:1 -stable -mdbc_freeslip ABS_RETAINED_ZERO_G_W_OR_CUBIC_SEED ABS_FRESH_OUTPUT; queries.csv, Run.out and completion.json only. Root must review and link against the receiver-head candidate's current source-frozen non-main CPU objects. Preserve failures; no automatic retries.
limits: Mixed receiver attribution only. It does not enable case08 three-plane contact, corners, dry/near/far activation, recentering, groundwater equilibrium, periodic gravity trajectory, moving walls, plasticity or physical acceptance. The retained periodic cloud is used as an initialization/neighbor fixture; query targets are interior and no gravity-time integration occurs.
